seccomp: Docker builtin allowlist; daemon version must be captured in evidence
workspace: readonly private assigned source snapshot; trusted scoped proposal/publication
git: no Git implementation or helpers; deny shim exits126 for every invocation

roles.layer: readonly assessment; test-only RED; owned production-only implementation
roles.composition: approved cmd paths; test-only RED; wiring-only implementation

proc_fallback: remove only one exact --proc /proc after known denial; user/PID/network namespaces mandatory
uncertified: Temporal cancellation and complete runtime failure cases
sdk_boundary: per-execution CLI OCI; readonly rootfs; sole regular-file writable tmpfs; trusted authenticated transport; certification-only

publication.failure_policy: durable PENDING/FAILED journal invalidates disposable attempt; no completion result, no verified commit

resource_policy.required: concurrent PIDs, CPU/time, memory/FD, command/result output, scratch/staging/publication, cleanup

sdk_private_state.publication_failure: existing durable FAILED journal; no runner result

go_dependency_provisioning.manifest: trusted SHA256 pin + complete inventory + native module checksums
